text:
marta: quick sync: we need a clear launch topology for Optimize toolkit recommendations (batching, caching, quant) + eval-triggered alerts. proposing three lanes: fast-path (opinionated defaults, self-serve), experimental (feature flags, short-lived recs), enterprise (custom profiles + audit). thoughts?
liam: three lanes seems safer. fast-path gets wide telemetry quickly, experimental lets us iterate recommendations, enterprise for customers needing audit/KMS.
sonya: agree. key is gating and acceptance per lane. suggest we make the fast-path acceptance minimal: econ uplift >= 2% and no more than 5% median latency regression on our benchmark corpus. experimental can be opt-in with looser gates.
zach: ops concern 10 supporting enterprise lane adds overhead (SLOs, runbooks, separate alerts). need an ops budget estimate before we commit.
devops-bot: noted: will create alert routing labels when lanes are final. propose labels `opt_lane=fast|exp|ent`.
ellen: pilot candidates for enterprise: CrestHealth (HIPAA) and NimbleAI (on-prem). experimental pilots: internal + 3 smaller customers. timeline idea: fast-path beta in Q2, experimental alpha Q2, enterprise pilot Q4.
marta: good. we also need quantitative gates for eval-triggered alerts. here's a suggested gating config for implementers: 
```json
{
  "lane": "fast",
  "gates": {
    "min_eval_samples": 2000,
    "f1_threshold": 0.6,
    "precision_threshold": 0.65,
    "max_false_pos_rate_pct": 12,
    "stability_window_hours": 72
  },
  "rollout": {
    "initial_percent": 5,
    "ramp_hours": 48
  }
}
```
liam: tweak: for enterprise set min_eval_samples to 10k and require audit_log=true. experimental can be 500 samples.
sonya: add a concordance check for customer prompt sets: concordance_score >= 0.6 for fast-path, >= 0.7 for enterprise.
zach: also mandate a rollback trigger: if cost_increase_pct > 4 OR user_quality_reports > 3x baseline in 24h -> auto-disable recs and notify SRE.
devops-bot: will add Prometheus alert `optimize_recs_rollbacks_total` and label by lane.
marta: what about quantization recommendations? runtime needs a safe default profile and a verification job. liam, can your team estimate dev time?
liam: runtime: ~3 sprints to stabilize quant profiles + 1 sprint for canary infra. that's assuming no major perf surprises.
ellen: acceptance criteria summary for docs: fast-path: econ_delta_pct >= 2; p50 latency delta <= 8%; concordance >= 0.6; eval_f1 >= 0.6. experimental: smoke tests only. enterprise: econ_delta_pct >= 3; concordance >= 0.7; audit logs enabled; quantization verification pass.
sonya: customer communication: all eval-triggered alerts must be explicit opt-in for experimental & enterprise. fast-path can be opt-out for trial customers. ensure we have UI toggle + API flag.
marta: next steps: i'll write the launch spec (lanes, gating, pilots, ops costs) and circulate. please react with :white_check_mark: if you agree with the three-lane topology.
liam: :white_check_mark:
sonya: :white_check_mark:
zach: :white_check_mark: (pending ops budget)
elllen: :white_check_mark:
marta: thanks folks 1. I'll ping when draft spec is ready for review and link the runbook PR.
